goal: Add Node mock-server /formato4 lifecycle routes (create→execute→poll→list→cancel→download zip) mirroring mtr + weighting, per the MTR-26 contract, so the Formato 4 UI clone works unchanged.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: POST /api/v1/formato4/runs with {country,period} returns 201 with status 'pending' and 5 pending steps named sync,merge,simulate,format_4,zip; 400 when country/period missing; 422 when period not integer
POST /api/v1/formato4/runs/:id/execute transitions run to 'running'; 404 unknown id; 409 when already running
GET /api/v1/formato4/runs/:id advances steps over time to completed with results_summary populated; 404 unknown id
POST /api/v1/formato4/runs/:id/cancel cancels a running/pending run (status cancelled); 409 on terminal run; 404 unknown id

GET /api/v1/formato4/runs/:id/download returns a real zip blob (Content-Type application/zip, Content-Disposition attachment filename format_4_<country>_<period>.csv.zip) for a completed run; 409 when not completed; 404 unknown id
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: vitest formato4.test.js asserts zip magic bytes PK + headers

acceptance_criteria.criterion: formato4 router registered in server.js and seeded; npm run mock boots and serves the routes

tasks.desc: Commit a small format_4 sample csv.zip fixture under mock-server/fixtures/
Write mock-server/routes/formato4.js (6 endpoints + seed) mirroring mtr/weighting, steps sync→merge→simulate→format_4→zip, by-runId zip download
Register formato4 router + seed in server.js and fixtures/seed.js
Write mock-server/__tests__/formato4.test.js covering all acceptance criteria (TDD)
Run vitest + boot smoke test; all green
